eas_text: A civil authority has issued A LOCAL AREA EMERGENCY for the following counties or areas: Garfield, UT; at 11:36 AM on AUG 31, 2025 Effective until 11:36 AM SEP 1, 2025. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: Escalante Boil Order in Effect DO NOT DRINK THE WATER WITHOUT BOILING IT FIRST. Bring all water to a boil, let it boil for 1 minute, and let it cool before use. Boiled or bottled water should be used for drinking, making ice, brushing teeth, washing dishes and food preparations until further notice. Visit www.escalanteutah.gov for updated information.
